title: Best Pool Service Software for Small Routes (2026, Sourced Prices)
description: Compare Skimmer, GorillaDesk, Jobber and Housecall Pro for pool routes: per-pool vs per-route pricing, chemical tools and route optimization, from vendor pages.
h1: Best pool service software for small routes
body:
Pool service is a route business: weekly recurring stops, chemical readings, and billing that depends on how many pools you service. The pricing models differ a lot, so the cheapest tool depends on your pool count and team size.

{{table:skimmer,gorilladesk,jobber,housecall-pro}}

1. Skimmer: built for pool routes

Skimmer charges per serviced location: $1/location/mo on Getting Started (starts at $49/mo, built for 0-49 pools) and $2/location/mo on Scaling Up (starts at $98/mo). Locations you don't service in a month aren't billed. Every plan includes unlimited technicians. Scaling Up adds route optimization, an LSI and dosing calculator powered by Orenda, and LaMotte integration. Right now Skimmer offers the first month of Scaling Up free, plus a 30-day refund guarantee. {{aff:skimmer|See Skimmer pricing}}

2. GorillaDesk: per-route pricing, unlimited users

GorillaDesk charges per route (technician schedule), not per user or per pool: Basic $49/mo, Pro $99/mo, Growth $149/mo for one route, month-to-month. Basic includes material tracking and reporting, plus routing capped at 25 stops. Pro adds Drive Matrix routing, a customer portal and QuickBooks Online sync. For a solo tech with a large route, that cap matters. {{aff:gorilladesk|See GorillaDesk pricing}}

3. Jobber: general-purpose, strongest for mixed work

Jobber isn't pool-specific (we found no chemical tracking on its pricing page; marked unknown). It can still fit pool businesses that also do repairs and one-off jobs. Core starts at $29/mo billed annually for 1 user. {{aff:jobber|See Jobber pricing}}

4. Housecall Pro: general-purpose, users included

Basic is $59/mo billed annually. Essentials adds routes and includes 5 users; MAX adds route optimization and recurring service plans. Pool-specific chemistry features: unknown. {{aff:housecallpro|See Housecall Pro pricing}}

Quick cost example (published list prices only)

  • Solo tech, 40 pools: Skimmer Getting Started is $49/mo (40 locations at $1, with a $49 minimum). GorillaDesk Basic is $49/mo for 1 route, but routing caps at 25 stops.
  • Solo tech, 80 pools on Scaling Up: the plan starts at $98/mo including 49 locations, plus $2 for each additional location (vendor terms). That's about $160/mo. Check the vendor's calculator before you commit.

faq: How much does pool service software cost?

Published entry prices we checked range from $29/mo (Jobber Core, billed annually) to $49/mo (Skimmer Getting Started, GorillaDesk Basic) and $59/mo (Housecall Pro Basic, billed annually). Checked 2026-10-21.
Which pool software charges per pool?
Skimmer bills per serviced location: $1 or $2 per location per month depending on plan.
Which pool service software includes unlimited technicians?
Skimmer includes unlimited techs and admins on every plan. GorillaDesk includes unlimited users and prices per route instead.
Which pool software offers route optimization?
Skimmer includes Route Builder on all plans and Route Optimization on Scaling Up. GorillaDesk has Drive Matrix routing on Pro, and Housecall Pro lists route optimization on MAX.
Do pool service software tools have free trials?

Skimmer currently offers the first month of Scaling Up free plus a 30-day refund guarantee. Jobber (Grow plan) and Housecall Pro (MAX plan) list 14-day free trials with no credit card. GorillaDesk offers a trial but doesn't state its length.
